title: Speed at highest point
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the speed at point C using the condition for circular motion at the top (mg = mv_C²/R).

title: Energy conservation B to C
description: Important Criteria: Applies conservation of mechanical energy between points B and C, accounting for the 2R height difference.

title: Normal force at B
description: Important Criteria: Correctly uses Newton's second law at point B to find the normal force from the track (F_N - mg = mv_B²/R).

title: Pressure at B (Newton's third law)
description: Essential Criteria: States that the pressure exerted by the slider on the track equals the normal force calculated at point B.

title: Spring energy with friction
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly applies energy conservation from A to B, equating spring potential energy to kinetic energy at B plus work done against friction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly signs the work done by friction or gravitational potential energy terms in energy equations.

title: Forgetting friction work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Omits the work done against friction (μmgL) when calculating the spring's potential energy.
